# Verified Installation of Posit

```{python}
#| echo: false

from pathlib import Path

from IPython.display import HTML, Markdown, display

from vip import report_html
from vip.reporting import load_troubleshooting, troubleshooting_path
from vip.traceability import report_inputs

# One read for the whole page: the summary, the cards and the traceability
# section below all describe the same results.json. See report_inputs.
_inputs = report_inputs(Path("results.json"))
data = _inputs.data
_troubleshooting_path = troubleshooting_path()
hints = load_troubleshooting(_troubleshooting_path) if _troubleshooting_path else {}

if data.total == 0:
    display(Markdown("> **No results found.** Run `pytest` to generate results."))
```

**Deployment:** `{python} data.deployment_name`
**Generated:** `{python} data.generated_at_display`

## Failures & Skips

```{python}
#| echo: false
if data.results:
    display(Markdown(
        "Every check that did not pass, in full. Passing checks are counted "
        "above — see [Detailed Results](details.qmd) for the complete listing."
    ))
display(HTML(report_html.render_actionable_cards(data, hints)))
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
# Rendered only when VIP_CONTROLS names a control list. report_inputs, called
# in the first cell, holds the reasons for that and for never raising -- see
# its docstring. The heading is emitted on both branches, because a compliance
# section that vanishes without saying so is the one outcome a regulated
# reader cannot detect.
_matrix, _trace_error = _inputs.matrix, _inputs.trace_error
if _matrix is not None:
    display(Markdown("## Compliance Traceability"))
    display(HTML(report_html.render_traceability(_matrix)))
elif _trace_error is not None:
    display(Markdown("## Compliance Traceability"))
    # HTML, not Markdown: IPython.display.Markdown passes raw HTML through in
    # Quarto, and this message carries the VIP_CONTROLS path and control ids
    # out of a customer-authored controls.toml. render_traceability_error
    # escapes it the way every other value report_html emits is escaped.
    display(HTML(report_html.render_traceability_error(_trace_error)))
```
